source_metadata.title: Infectious Diseases Society of America 2026 Guidance on the Treatment of Antimicrobial-Resistant Gram-Negative Infections
source_metadata.content_scope: Section 2 AmpC beta-lactamase-producing Enterobacterales content present on PDF pages 22-29

extraction_limitations: The governing LiteratureAtom MVP is designed for primary literature, while ciag481.pdf is an IDSA guidance document. Guideline recommendations were mapped to atom_kind=author_conclusion because the schema has no guideline_recommendation kind.

Quantitative and qualitative findings summarized from cited studies are atoms of what the guidance reports, not re-extractions from the cited primary publications; these atoms are tagged secondary_evidence_summary and should not be treated as primary-study provenance.
The trailing ESBL-E sentence at the top of PDF page 22 was excluded because it belongs to Section 1 and would duplicate the prior semantic batch boundary.
Question 2.7 begins on PDF page 29, but its rationale begins on page 30. Only the suggested approach on page 29 was extracted; no page-30 content was used.
No content before PDF page 22 or after PDF page 29 was used to create atoms in this batch, apart from publication metadata needed to identify the source.
All generated atoms are marked needs_review; structural/schema/sufficiency validation does not constitute human verification of extraction fidelity.
